Bihar Election 2025 LIVE: In a high-stakes political development ahead of the Bihar Assembly Elections 2025, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and RJD’s Tejashwi Yadav have come together for a joint rally in Muzaffarpur. This public show of alliance is aimed at consolidating the anti-BJP vote bank and showcasing unity between the INDIA bloc partners in the state.

Full Speech – Kishanganj, Bihar Election 2025

title: Bihar Election LIVE: UP CM Yogi Adityanath Addresses Public Rally In Motihari| BJP | NDA | RJD |CONG
description:
Bihar Election LIVE: UP CM Yogi Adityanath Addresses Public Rally In Motihari| BJP | NDA | RJD |CONG

Bihar Election LIVE:  UP CM Yogi Adityanath addressed a massive public rally in Motihari (East Champaran), Bihar, amid the 2025 Bihar Assembly Elections. In his speech, he emphasized Bihar’s journey from "jungle raj" to progress under the leadership of Nitish Kumar and PM Narendra Modi. Yogi Adityanath strongly criticized the opposition parties RJD and Congress, labeling them as dynastic "khandani mafia," attacking their politics and governance style. He highlighted the NDA’s development agenda against what he called the family welfare politics of the rivals.

Yogi also touched on sensitive topics like "burqa and bulldozer," voter verification issues, and the alleged misuse of votes by illegal voters, aiming to consolidate non-Yadav Hindu votes under the NDA coalition's banner. His rhetoric focused on contrasting development and good governance with corruption and "jungle raj," warning voters against a return to lawlessness if opposition parties come to power.

This public rally in Motihari is part of a larger campaign by the BJP and NDA to unite Hindu votes and counter the Mahagathbandhan (RJD, Congress and others), showcasing a strategy similar to successful BJP campaigns in other states. The rally was characterized by strong political messaging around governance, development, voter identity security, and anti-dynastic politics themes ahead of the crucial Bihar polls.

description:
Bihar Election LIVE: UP CM Yogi Adityanath Addresses Public Rally In Bhelwa, Dhaka | Champaran |NDA 

Bihar Election LIVE: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath addressed a massive public rally in Bhelwa (Dhaka), East Champaran, as part of the NDA's high-voltage campaign for the Bihar Assembly Election 2025. Thousands of enthusiastic supporters gathered, raising thunderous slogans of "Yogi-Yogi" and "Jai Shri Ram" to welcome the firebrand leader. Yogi launched a scathing attack on the Mahagathbandhan (RJD-Congress), warning that their return would bring back Jungle Raj, mafia rule, crime, and infiltrators. He highlighted NDA's achievements – free ration, housing, toilets, electricity, water, women's safety, and bulldozer action against criminals. Yogi urged voters to strengthen the double-engine government for faster development, jobs for youth, and to restore Bihar as the land of knowledge. He appealed to voters in the second phase on November 11 to give the NDA a historic mandate in Dhaka and across all seats. The rally turned into a mega show of strength for NDA, giving a massive boost ahead of polling.

title: MODI LIVE : PM Modi Addresses Public Meeting At Darbhanga, Bihar | 2019 Election Campaign BJP
description:
MODI LIVE : PM Modi Addresses Public Meeting At Darbhanga, Bihar  2019 Election Campaign BJP
#ModiDarbhanga

Prime Minister Narendra Modi is coming to Bihar on an election tour once again. They will address the meeting in favor of BJP candidate of Darbhanga Gopalji Thakur. It is believed that its impact will affect the mathilanchal's political math.According to the information, the meeting of PM Modi will begin at 10 a.m. Chief Minister Nitish Kumar will also be there. BJP claims that the visit of PM Modi will be the communication of enthusiasm in Mithilanchal's political fight.Let us know that in the last elections, BJP had won two Mithilanchal seats. Kirti Azad from Darbhanga, Hukumdev Narayan Yadav from Madhubani elevated the BJP's flag.However, once the alliance is united by the alliance, the political equation seems to have changed slightly. But BJP is feeling a bit relieved by the arrival of Congress candidate Shakeel Ahmed in Madhubani.As per the program of PM Modi's Bihar tour, he will be at Darbhanga Airport at 9.55 in the morning. At 10 a.m., the meeting place will be departing for Raj Ground by road.They will arrive at the venue at 10.15 pm and they will be addressing people till 10.45 hrs. At 10.50 pm, Darbhanga Airport will be departing from the road. Darbhanga Airport will arrive at 11.05 hrs and at 1110 hrs the aircraft will fly from the IAF C-130 and reach Khajuraho Airport in Madhya Pradesh at 12.45 hrs.Tell that PM Modi will return to Bihar on April 30 and will address the meeting in favor of BJP candidate Ajay Nishad in Muzaffarpur.Before this, BJP national president Amit Shah will hold meetings in the favor of JD (U) candidate Sunil Kumar Pintu in Sitamarhi and in favor of Rajiv Pratap Rudy of Saran.

title: PM Modi Bihar Visit Live : थोड़ी देर में पीएम मोदी की जनसभा शुरू! |Bihar Election |BJP |Karpuri Gram
description:
PM Modi Bihar Visit Live : थोड़ी देर में पीएम मोदी की जनसभा शुरू! |Bihar Election |BJP |Karpuri Gram

Prime Minister Narendra Modi will start the election campaign from Samastipur for Bihar Assembly elections. His aim is to strengthen NDA's hold on 30 seats of Mithilanchal. In this rally the focus will be on development and social equations. This meeting at the birthplace of Karpoori Thakur is creating uneasiness in the opposition, because NDA is trying to further increase the seats won in the 2020 elections.
